description: This file defines the class PersistableCustomerAttribute which extends CustomerAttributeEntity and manages customer option data, including associated getter and setter methods.

classes.name: PersistableCustomerAttribute
classes.description: A persistable entity representing customer attribute options and their values, extending CustomerAttributeEntity.

methods.name: setCustomerOptionValue
methods.description: Sets the CustomerOptionValue object for this attribute.

methods.name: getCustomerOptionValue
methods.description: Retrieves the CustomerOptionValue associated with this attribute.

methods.name: setCustomerOption

methods.name: getCustomerOption
methods.description: Retrieves the CustomerOption associated with this attribute.
